title: Catalog common definitions
description: The types the kinds of catalog entry share.

CatalogId.description: The identity of an entry: its area, its kind and its name, as in transport/metric/rsl; the file of an entry is catalog/<id>/<version>.yaml.

CatalogValue.description: The value of a metric or a control parameter.

unit.description: The unit of a number, as the catalog writes it: dBm, dB, Mbps, ms, s, ratio, count.

values.description: The values of an enumerated string.

CatalogArea.$comment: Provisional: the reference definition of the implementation guide (Section 11.4), from the kinds and attributes of [FW] Section 3.6, stands in for [IMPL] Annex B until it arrives; work item D.3 replaces it.
CatalogArea.description: The manifest of an area of the catalog, catalog/<area>/area.yaml: its owner and the classes of managed object its entries describe.
